title: Potential bug in _inductor/runtime/cache_dir_utils.py
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

When TRITON_CACHE_DIR env is set, the device id is not appended to the cache directory (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/33e6c5a93d4e249d3a05cbe434877b8a77922a90/torch/_inductor/runtime/cache_dir_utils.py#L31)

This might result in a failure on this line (https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/33e6c5a93d4e249d3a05cbe434877b8a77922a90/torch/_inductor/triton_bundler.py#L394) with multiple ranks trying to replace to the same trajectory. 

I can send a fix, but I want to understand first if this is my misunderstanding of the docs, and we expect TRITON_CACHE_DIR per rank. Or (which will be more consistent with the code path with the unset TRITON_CACHE_DIR, we will append the str(device) to avoid the crash.

I do not have a small reproducible example rn, but the crash I get is on the os.replace() call with  this: 

```bash
torch._dynamo.exc.BackendCompilerFailed: backend='inductor' raised: [rank3]: OSError: [Errno 39] Directory not empty:
```

### Versions

```bash
torch==2.8.0a0+5228986c39.nv25.6
```
